  "memo":"R03 holds: the GB-issued card was used from a US IP and AVS failed. Card is the only adverse family; no other rule holds. The longstanding card, established device, matching CVV and home delivery make legitimate use plausible, but do not override R03. No checks have completed. Recommend needs_check under §6.6(b), implemented as a hold with issuer authentication and identity verification. Contact is not required. A passed id_check requires clear; a failed check requires decline because Linkage is absent. The order is unshipped, so a hold can still pause fulfilment."
